title: Frankie Dusen could not read music
summary: Barnes doubts Dusen taught bands since he could not read, recalling him in the WPA band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Oh, talking about Frankie Dooson, somebody told us that he used to go down in the country, I believe on the other side of the river, and taught some of the bands, like Sam Morgan's band or something. Did you ever hear of Frankie Dooson teaching anybody or going around? He didn't know nothing about music itself.

I wonder, too, somebody told me he couldn't read. I wonder how he could go around and teach a band. It's wrong, it's wrong. The last place I played with him, I don't know, I went in, of course we had a project band, we used to call it WPA band, you know? And he was in there when he was signed up and was in there before I was. I went in there front of me, and he was just blind as he ever was, around that line. He couldn't, he couldn't read.
